pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Space Mountain Pin Set (Series 1 of 12)

price_sources.name: eBay listing surfaced via web search (asking price, not a confirmed sold comp)
price_sources.note: Single data point: one Series 1/12 Limited Release set observed at $100.00, described in the aggregated result as an older listing. Series 1 is the most sought-after Minnie drop because it was park-only (no shopDisney channel). Treat as a weak upper anchor, not a median.

pins.notes: Three-pin boxed set on a futuristic Space Mountain-styled card: Minnie in ride-themed costume, a glitter Space Mountain icon, and a matching ear-headband pin. Official on-sale Saturday Jan 18 2020, but sets were spotted at Disney's Hollywood Studios as early as Sun Jan 12 2020. Series 1 and 2 were sold in person only at Walt Disney World and Disneyland Resort — no online channel — which is a key scarcity driver. Component PinPics IDs seen: 138034 (Minnie figure), 138035 (earband). Pin & Pop database IDs: 29722 (full set), 29724 (ears only), 29725 (glitter Space Mountain only).

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Pirates of the Caribbean Pin Set (Series 2 of 12)
pins.notes: Three-pin set: Minnie in pirate costume, a skull-with-bow attraction icon, and February's ear-headband pin. Last of the two park-only drops (WDW and Disneyland Resort in person; no online sale). SKU is the shopDisney US product ID from the disneystore.com listing. Component PinPics ID seen: 138322 (Skull with Bow). Pin & Pop full-set ID: 30206.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Mad Tea Party Pin Set (Series 3 of 12)

price_sources.name: eBay (price surfaced via web search summary; described as a sold price)
price_sources.note: Single observation of ~$27.69, reported as of mid-July 2025. One data point only; not a multi-comp median.

pins.notes: Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, a teacup icon, and an ear-hat pin. First drop of the series affected by the COVID-19 park closure — sold online only at shopDisney (March 21 2020, 10AM ET / 7AM PT), which launched Disney's MerchPass lottery model used for the rest of the run. PinPics 138522 is a set-level entry ('DIS - March Set - Minnie Main Attraction - Mad Tea Party'). Pin & Pop: 32287 (full set), 32288 (Minnie only). Also catalogued on StockX.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — it's a small world Pin Set (Series 4 of 12)

price_sources.name: eBay listing surfaced via web search (asking price)
price_sources.note: Single asking-price observation of $29.50 for a sealed Series 4/12 set. Not a sold comp.

pins.notes: Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, the small world clock-face icon, and the ear headband. shopDisney-exclusive drop April 18 2020 at 10AM ET while parks were closed; the site had heavy traffic glitches. Restocked on shopDisney in June 2020, and again in the August 2020 full-series restock — so supply is higher than the park-only Series 1/2. PinPics 139400 is a set-level entry ('DIS - April Set ... 2020 - Clock'). Pin & Pop: 32994 (Minnie only), 32996 (ears only).

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — The Enchanted Tiki Room Pin Set (Series 5 of 12)

price_sources.name: eBay listing surfaced via web search (asking price)
price_sources.note: Single asking-price observation of $34.99 for an Enchanted Tiki Room set. Not a sold comp.

pins.notes: Three pins: Minnie in Tiki-themed costume, José the macaw, and the matching ear headband. shopDisney release May 16 2020. Component PinPics ID seen: 140060 ('DS - Main Attraction - Minnie - Enchanted Tiki Room Minnie'). Pin & Pop: 33907 (full set), 33909 (Minnie only), 33910 (José only). Physical stock later turned up in the parks — WDWNT photographed Tiki Room sets at Walt Disney World in September 2020.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Peter Pan's Flight Pin Set (Series 6 of 12)
pins.notes: Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, the pirate galleon / Jolly Roger icon, and the ear headband. Messy release history — an initial June 20 2020 shopDisney drop, then the series was suspended for the summer, and the collection was re-offered July 27 2020 at 10AM ET through the new MerchPass lottery. SKU is the shopDisney US product ID. Component PinPics IDs seen: 140023 (Minnie), 140025 (Pirate Ship). Pin & Pop: 35054 (full set), 37399 (ears only). Also sold at Hong Kong Disneyland / Shanghai Disney Store channels per reseller listings.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — King Arthur Carrousel Pin Set (Series 7 of 12)

price_sources.name: eBay listing surfaced via web search (asking price)
price_sources.note: Single asking-price observation of $39.99 for a Series 7/12 King Arthur Carrousel set. Not a sold comp.

pins.notes: Nominally the July 2020 collection but released Tuesday Aug 11 2020 via MerchPass after the summer suspension. Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, a carrousel horse, and the ear headband. Notably themed to DISNEYLAND's King Arthur Carrousel — the Mickey series two years later used Walt Disney World's Prince Charming Regal Carrousel instead, so the two 'carrousel' pins are different attractions. PinPics 140127 is a set-level entry ('DIS - July Set'); 140129 is the Minnie figure. Pin & Pop: 35723 (carrousel horse only), 35725 (ears only).

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Dumbo the Flying Elephant Pin Set (Series 8 of 12)

price_sources.name: eBay listing surfaced via web search (asking price)
price_sources.note: Single asking-price observation of $30.00 for a Series 8/12 Dumbo set. Not a sold comp.

pins.notes: August 2020 collection, released via shopDisney/MerchPass. Release date left null on purpose: Disney announced the Dumbo and Big Thunder dates together on Aug 8 2020 and one aggregated source gives Aug 18 2020, but I could not corroborate that against a primary post, and the rest of the run's MerchPass drops fell on later Tuesdays. Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, a Dumbo ride vehicle icon, and the ear headband. Component PinPics ID seen: 140886. Pin & Pop full-set ID: 36177.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Big Thunder Mountain Railroad Pin Set (Series 9 of 12)
pins.notes: September 2020 collection, MerchPass drop Sept 15 2020. Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, a Big Thunder attraction icon, and the ear headband. PinPics 140458 is a set-level entry ('DIS - September Set'); 140460 is the Minnie figure in costume. Pin & Pop full-set ID: 36827. Also distributed through Shanghai Disney Resort / Hong Kong Disneyland channels per reseller listings.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — The Haunted Mansion Pin Set (Series 10 of 12)
pins.notes: MerchPass drop Tuesday Oct 13 2020 (drawing window 7:00AM–11:59PM PT that day). Themed to Disneyland's Haunted Mansion. Three pins: Minnie in themed costume, an attraction icon, and the ear headband. Widely regarded as one of the most in-demand Minnie drops because Haunted Mansion is an evergreen collector subject. SKU is the shopDisney UK product ID for 'Pin Set, 10 of 12'. Pin & Pop full-set ID: 37251.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Jungle Cruise Pin Set (Series 11 of 12)
pins.notes: MerchPass drop Tuesday Nov 17 2020. Themed to Disneyland's Jungle Cruise. Three pins: Minnie in skipper costume, an attraction icon, and the ear headband. SKU is the shopDisney EU product ID for 'Pin Set, 11 of 12'. Component PinPics ID seen: 145098 ('DIS - Earband - Minnie Main Attraction - Jungle Cruise').

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Nighttime Fireworks & Castle Finale Pin Set (Series 12 of 12)
pins.notes: The series finale — not a ride but the nighttime castle-and-fireworks spectaculars at Disneyland and Magic Kingdom, so this is also a castle pin and a crossover with Family B. MerchPass drawings opened Tuesday Dec 8 2020 at 7AM PT, pulled forward from the expected mid-December slot. Three pins: Minnie in a fireworks-themed costume, a castle/fireworks icon, and the ear headband. Component PinPics ID seen: 141611 ('DIS - Minnie - Main Attraction - Fireworks - December 2020'). Pin & Pop full-set ID: 38149 ('Series 12: Castle Fireworks'). Because it closed the set, this drop is a common completion bottleneck for collectors chasing all 12.

pins.name: Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction — Fantasyland Castle Album Starter/Completer Pin
pins.notes: The hidden 13th pin of the Minnie Main Attraction run and a genuine castle pin. A Fantasyland-castle-shaped starter pin that came only with the $29.99 'Minnie Mouse: The Main Attraction Pin Collector's Album' (Limited Release, shopDisney / Disney Store, released alongside Series 1 on Jan 18 2020). It was never sold separately, so completists have to buy the album to get it. retail_price_usd left null because the $29.99 was the album price, not a pin price. SKU is the shopDisney US product ID for the album.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Space Mountain Pin (1 of 12)
pins.notes: First of the Mickey companion series, tied to the Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary celebration. Unlike the Minnie run, each Mickey month was a SINGLE pin, not a three-pin set. Debuted in-park at Disney Springs Mar 14 2022; shopDisney US release Apr 14 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT. Series pricing was $24.99 or $29.99 with no apparent pattern — retail left null because I could not confirm which tier this pin used. Mickey stands in an identical pose on every pin of the series, costumed to the attraction, with varying printed detail, pin-on-pin elements, and glitter accents.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Pirates of the Caribbean Pin (2 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release May 6 2022 at 7AM PT / 10AM ET. PinPics ID not confirmed — a PinPics entry numbered 147588 titled simply 'Mickey Mouse' appeared in searches near the other Main Attraction entries and may be this pin, but I could not verify it, so pinpics_id is null rather than guessed.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Mad Tea Party Pin (3 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release May 20 2022 at 7AM PT. Third Mickey month; matches the Minnie series month-for-month by attraction.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — it's a small world Pin (4 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Jun 17 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT. First look published by WDWNT in April 2022.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Enchanted Tiki Room Pin (5 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Jul 1 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT. PinPics entry title is 'Mickey Mouse - Enchanted Tiki Room'.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Peter Pan's Flight Pin (6 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Jul 18 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT; the in-park Magic Kingdom rollout followed in early August 2022.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Prince Charming Regal Carrousel Pin (7 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Aug 12 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT, $24.99 — the one Mickey month where I could confirm the retail tier. Note the attraction swap versus Minnie: Mickey got Walt Disney World's Prince Charming Regal Carrousel where Minnie's Series 7 used Disneyland's King Arthur Carrousel. Pin & Pop ID: 54467.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Dumbo the Flying Elephant Pin (8 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Aug 26 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Big Thunder Mountain Railroad Pin (9 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Friday Oct 7 2022 at 10AM ET / 7AM PT; in-park rollout at Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World followed in November 2022.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — The Haunted Mansion Pin (10 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Nov 9 2022. SKU is the shopDisney Asia product ID for 'Series 10 of 12'. Mickey is costumed as a Haunted Mansion character; frequently the most traded Mickey month.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Jungle Cruise Pin (11 of 12)
pins.notes: shopDisney US release Dec 2 2022. SKU is the shopDisney Asia product ID for 'Series 11 of 12'.

pins.name: Mickey Mouse: The Main Attraction — Cinderella Castle Fireworks Pin (12 of 12)
pins.notes: Series finale and the second castle crossover in Family A — explicitly Cinderella Castle with fireworks, matching Minnie's 'Nighttime Fireworks & Castle' finale. shopDisney release Dec 21 2022 (the ears from the same collection dropped that day). Announced back in December 2021 as the planned Series 12 theme. Collector commentary at the time judged the Mickey line commercially weaker than the Minnie line, which is a plausible reason Mickey pins trade closer to retail.

pins.name: Cinderella Castle Pin — Disney Castle Collection (Series 1 of 10)
pins.notes: Opening pin of the shopDisney 'Disney Castle Collection' — ten releases, each a never-before-seen portrayal of an animated heroine's castle, with a matching figurine, ornament, journal and puzzle. The pin is a hinged cloisonné piece that opens to reveal a collage of interior settings. Released Saturday Apr 4 2020 at 10AM ET, $29.99. Important: these are 'Limited Release' (sold for a limited window), NOT numbered Limited Edition — there is no stated edition size for any pin in the series, so edition_size is null throughout. SKU is the shopDisney US product ID. Pin & Pop lists a 'Complete Series (Display Case and all 11 Pins)' entry (ID 48934), implying an eleventh display-case pin beyond the ten heroine castles; I could not verify what that eleventh pin is.

pins.name: Arendelle Castle Pin — Frozen — Disney Castle Collection (Series 2 of 10)
pins.notes: Second Castle Collection release, the Arendelle castle from Frozen (Anna and Elsa), debuting June 2020. Exact release date not confirmed; retail left null — the series pins were consistently around $29.99 but I only confirmed that figure for Series 1.

pins.name: Mulan Castle Pin — Disney Castle Collection (Series 3 of 10)
pins.notes: Third Castle Collection release (the Imperial Palace from Mulan), 2020. Series ordering is corroborated by the published film order (Cinderella, Frozen, Mulan, Snow White, Tangled, Sleeping Beauty, Aladdin, The Little Mermaid, Brave, Beauty and the Beast) and cross-checks against the confirmed numbering for Aurora 6/10, Jasmine 7/10, Merida 9/10 and Belle 10/10. Release date not confirmed.

pins.name: Snow White Castle Pin — Disney Castle Collection (Series 4 of 10)
pins.property: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
pins.notes: Fourth Castle Collection release, on sale Nov 7 2020 via shopDisney.

pins.name: Rapunzel Castle Pin — Tangled — Disney Castle Collection (Series 5 of 10)
pins.notes: Fifth Castle Collection release (the Corona castle from Tangled). Year inferred as 2021 from the series cadence — releases slipped badly and collectors on DISboards were still tracking an incomplete series into 2021. Release date not confirmed.

pins.name: Aurora Castle Pin — Sleeping Beauty — Disney Castle Collection (Series 6 of 10)
pins.notes: Sixth Castle Collection release, explicitly numbered 6/10 by resellers. This is the ANIMATED Sleeping Beauty castle (King Stefan's castle from the 1959 film), not the Disneyland park icon — worth distinguishing for a collector sorting castle pins. Release date not confirmed; a March 2021 KennythePirate post announced a date for 'the next series' around this point in the run.

pins.name: Jasmine Castle Pin — Aladdin — Disney Castle Collection (Series 7 of 10)
pins.notes: Seventh Castle Collection release (the Palace of Agrabah), Apr 27 2021, numbered 7/10 on retail listings.

pins.name: Ariel Castle Pin — The Little Mermaid — Disney Castle Collection (Series 8 of 10)
pins.notes: Eighth Castle Collection release (Prince Eric's castle), 2021. Position inferred from the published film order and confirmed by the surrounding numbering (Jasmine 7/10, Merida 9/10). Release date not confirmed.

pins.name: Merida Castle Pin — Brave — Disney Castle Collection (Series 9 of 10)
pins.notes: Ninth Castle Collection release (Castle DunBroch), on sale Saturday Dec 4 2021 at 12AM PT. Franchise recorded as Pixar since Brave is a Pixar film, though it sits inside a Disney Princess-framed series.

pins.name: Belle Castle Pin — Beauty and the Beast — Disney Castle Collection (Series 10 of 10)
pins.notes: Final Castle Collection release (the Beast's castle), Feb 17 2022 — closing out a series that took almost two years instead of the expected ten months. As the completer it is the usual sticking point for anyone assembling the set.

pins.name: Cinderella Castle — Blue Castle with Fireworks Pin (Open Edition)
pins.notes: One of the standard blue-enamel Cinderella Castle open-edition park pins — the castle rendered in blue with fireworks bursts behind it. This is a strong candidate for one of the three similar blue castle pins in the collector's holdings. Catalogued by Pin & Pop as 'Blue Castle with Fireworks' under the Cinderella Castle series (Pin & Pop ID 35568). Open-edition park pins like this are produced in large volume over long windows, typically retail around $10–$13 and resell at or below retail, so market values are left null rather than guessed. Year unknown — open editions frequently carry no year in the art.

pins.name: Cinderella Castle Balloons Pin
pins.notes: Current-release open-edition pin showing Cinderella Castle with Mickey balloons, released 2026 at Walt Disney World. Still on sale as of this research, so retired is false.

pins.name: Disney Magic Kingdom Park Icons Pin — Cinderella Castle & Partners Statue
pins.notes: Open-edition pin from the Disney Parks 'Park Icons' series: Cinderella Castle plus the Partners statue, lavender background with the castle icon in blue and a silver-tone finish. Another plausible match for a 'blue castle pin' in a collection because the castle itself is blue enamel. Catalogued as Disney Pinventory item 41949.

pins.name: Cinderella Build-A-Pin — Cinderella Castle Base Pin (with Fairy Godmother and Cinderella attachments)
pins.park_specific: Emporium, Magic Kingdom (also released at Disneyland)
pins.notes: Build-A-Pin base pin featuring Cinderella Castle against a blue sparkly background, with two separately sold attachment pins (Fairy Godmother, and Cinderella in her torn pink dress). Spotted at the Emporium in Magic Kingdom and released at Disneyland in the same July 2026 wave. Strong candidate for a 'blue glitter castle pin' in a collection. Edition type recorded as Open Edition based on the Build-A-Pin program's normal model; not explicitly stated in the source.

pins.name: WDW — Lilo & Stitch — Cinderella's Castle Pin
pins.notes: Older Walt Disney World character-plus-castle pin pairing Lilo & Stitch with Cinderella's Castle; catalogued on PinPics as 24103 (a low PinPics number, consistent with an early-2000s release). Edition type and year not confirmed, so both are left unstated rather than guessed. Included as an example of the very large 'character in front of Cinderella Castle' pin family, which is where most casual castle pins in a collection come from.

pins.name: Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary — Cinderella Castle Pin (2021)
pins.notes: Cinderella Castle pin from the Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary (The World's Most Magical Celebration) 2021 range, showing the castle in its EARidescent 50th dress. Catalogued in two third-party databases: Pin Trading DB entry 43019 and My Pin Central entry 65451 — those are NOT PinPics numbers, so pinpics_id is null. Edition type not confirmed; the 50th range spanned open editions, limited releases and numbered LEs.

pins.name: Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary — Logo Cinderella's Castle Pin (2021)
pins.notes: Distinct 50th-anniversary pin combining the celebration logo with Cinderella's Castle; My Pin Central entry 139384 (not a PinPics ID). Recorded separately from the plain 50th castle pin above because the database titles differ, but be aware these two records could turn out to be variants of one design.

pins.name: Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary — Iridescent Cinderella Castle Pin
pins.notes: The EARidescent-finish Cinderella Castle pin from the 50th range — the castle rendered in the shifting pearl/iridescent palette used across the 50th merchandise line. pin_type 'pearlized' is used as the closest schema value for the iridescent finish. Year not stated on the listing; the 50th ran Oct 2021 – Mar 2023.

pins.name: Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary Countdown — Cinderella Castle Pin
pins.notes: Numbered limited-edition Cinderella Castle pin from the 50th Anniversary Countdown range, stated as LE 3,000. The source also gave a physical size but the measurement was truncated ('..." w x 1 3/8" h'), so size_mm is null. Year not stated; the countdown range ran in the run-up to Oct 1 2021.

pins.name: Cinderella Castle Pin — Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary — Disney Visa Cardmember Exclusive 2022
pins.notes: Disney Visa Cardmember exclusive, Limited Release, on sale from Feb 17 2022 at $12.99. Goldtone finish with faceted rhinestones set into the Cinderella Castle icon. Purchase was gated to Disney Visa cardholders, which caps supply without a numbered edition size. SKU is the shopDisney US product ID.

pins.name: Walt Disney World 50th Anniversary — Cinderella Castle Pink Hinged Jumbo Pin (2022)
pins.notes: Jumbo hinged Cinderella Castle pin from the 50th, 3D-sculpted with the castle in the shiny pink-purple 50th anniversary dress. edition_size deliberately left null: one aggregated source described a jumbo 50th castle pin as LE 3,000, but that figure appeared alongside a separate LE 3,000 countdown pin and I could not attribute it cleanly to this jumbo, so it is unconfirmed. Jumbo LE castle pins are the top of the castle-pin market and routinely trade well above the open-edition park pins.

pins.name: Cinderella Castle 50th Anniversary Limited Edition Pin — Third in Series (2022)
pins.series: Cinderella Castle 50th Anniversary Limited Edition series
pins.notes: WDWNT reported the arrival of the THIRD limited-edition 50th Anniversary Cinderella Castle pin at Walt Disney World in April 2022, confirming that a multi-pin LE castle sub-series ran through the 50th at Disney's Pin Traders in Disney Springs. Further 50th castle LEs kept appearing into July 2022. The total series length and the individual edition sizes are not documented in what I could reach, so both are null.

pins.name: Mickey and Minnie Mouse at Fantasyland Castle — Happy Place Pin
pins.notes: Current 2026 'Happy Place' pin showing Mickey and Minnie in front of the Fantasyland castle. Origin recorded as Disneyland Resort because 'Fantasyland Castle' in Disney pin nomenclature normally means Sleeping Beauty Castle, but the source listing did not name the park explicitly — treat the resort attribution as provisional. Included because Sleeping Beauty Castle coverage is otherwise the thinnest part of this dataset.
